there is not already a function for this on proto.c ? (like varint?)

There is no function that fits this encoding.

The encoding is documented here https://erlang.org/doc/apps/erts/erl_ext_dist.html#small_big_ext
 
For the smaller integers (=< 64 bits) the get_uint64_value function from proto.c would be helpful and could replace the switch, but that function is not exported.
None of the other functions works even for smaller integers because of the encoding of the sign field. Using a full byte and not only the MSB is so unusual that none of decoding functions supports that.
Also, an 8 bytes long SMALL_BIG_EXT would need 65 bits due to the sign bit.

The varint functions deal with  encoding schemes that are not compatible with the Erlang encoding. I could add a Erlang version to them, but I'm not sure that it really is worth the effort.
I think, should be a good idea to add ERLANG version to varint (like QUIC or other protocol)

After thinking a bit more about it, I still don't see how that fits the existing APIs in a sensible way.

The other protocols have a maximum size of 64 bits for integers encoded in a maximum of 10 bytes (FT_VARINT_MAX_LEN), Erlang maximum integer size is 2^40bits stored in 2^32 bytes plus one extra byte for the sign.

So, either you can accept this version or I drop the BIG_EXT decoding entirely from this MR.
